title: Bug recording
recordingStatus: Recording a bug report. Text and pictures aren’t filmed.
discardMessage: The recording and the problems you marked will be lost.
expectationHint: Goes into the report as you write it, so leave out anything personal.
problemsHint: Move to where it went wrong and press Problem here.
privacy: The video shows only the app’s layout: every line of text is a grey bar and every picture a grey box. The report leaves out what you wrote, who you are and which server you use.
